title: Fun way to explore Barcelona
text:
So much fun!
Our guide Illya was very nice, knowledgeable and attentive to our Segway tour of Barcelona. This was our first time on segways at age 70.  Remarkable machines. 
We visited several sites including Sagrada Família and Casa Batllo, and others.
author: Ray519

title: Wonderful experience
text: Best way to tour and see all the things! Elijah was patient and super friendly. Was very knowledgeable
author: Andrea_B

title: Elijah was a great guide...
text:
Elijah was a great guide and very friendly. 
He showed us very cool and had lots of information. I would tell a friend to do it!
author: Emilie_G

title: Fabulous
text: Oskar was a first-class guide who, after professional training, showed us places in Barcelona we didn't know yet. We are still excited about the SegwayTour.
author: AniJosRo

title: Excellent for teens
text: Such good fun . Went with 3 teenage boys and we had a mix of Segway and bikes . Daniel was a great guide and judged our group well with just enough history to keep the teens engaged. We chose this as they get bored on a bus tour . I highly recommend, our teens and we loved it . It’s a great fun way to see the city and better value than the bus tour imo .
author: Ruth_T

title: Excellent, unique family-friendly activity
text: We traveled as a family of 6, ages 16-50, and this tour with Ruslan was definitely a highlight of our trip. I was a little uncomfortable the Segway, and Ruslan suggested I switch to an ebike, which was wonderful. We covered so much ground and had a fun time zooming up to see the Gaudi archetecture and down to the beach. All of the kids felt very comfortable operating the Segways and understanding the traffic laws. Barcelona is such a bike friendly city we felt very safe. Such a fun afternoon!
author: Emily_P

title: Fantastic experience with our guide Ruslan
text: Absolutely brilliant experience. My wife and I had never rode segways before and the training was perfect. Took us minutes to be whizzing around. Our guide Ruslan was amazing. Shared some brilliant knowledge at each stops and was a very good guide as we navigated the roads of Barcelona. The group was a nice size of 6 so it still felt super comfortable and personal. Would highly recommend to anyone wanting to cram in some sightseeing with a different mode of transport! Even had time to stop and snap pictures at some of the sights!
author: christopherbF2838XN

title: New to Barcelona & Segways
text: No one in our family of four had ever been on a Segway before. We range in age from 16-57 and rate our experience outstanding. Our guides, Pablo and Luke, were fun, knew their Gaudi and personable.
author: Mberkshire

title: Excellent activity, can...
text: Excellent activity, can see both beach and city. Driving is not as easy as it looks though so take it slow!
author: AC_w

title: BEST BEST BEST
text: This is the best way to tour Barcelona.  We are both around 70 and had some hesitation about our ability to control the Segway and about traffic safety.  Our concerns were unnecessary because our guide, Pablo from Brazil, made sure we were comfortable and competent before we went on the tour.  His knowledge of history and art added so much to the tour.  Without him, we would have missed so much.
author: Cate780
